description: This file defines the ListStringItem class, a Drupal plugin for a custom field type 'list_string'. It includes property definitions, schema, allowed values description, validation, casting, storage settings form, and machine name processing.

classes.name: ListStringItem
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class implementing a 'list_string' field type, extending ListItemBase, with methods for property definitions, schema, validation, and storage configuration.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the data properties for the field, specifically a 'value' string with a max length of 255.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Provides the database schema for the field, with a varchar(255) column named 'value'.

methods.name: allowedValuesDescription
methods.description: Returns an HTML description explaining how allowed values are used and HTML tags permitted.

methods.name: validateAllowedValue
methods.description: Validates that a value's length does not exceed 255 characters.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds a form for storage settings, including machine name configuration for allowed values.

methods.name: processAllowedValuesKey
methods.description: Sets the machine name source to be the label, overriding default behavior.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a machine name key already exists; always returns FALSE as form state is unavailable.
